headings: How do I use the W4 Plus for translation and calls?
paras: The W4 Plus is designed for effortless, hands‑free communication. Here's how it works:
For one‑on‑one conversations: Simply share the earbuds — one for you, one for your conversation partner. The device automatically translates in real time, so you can speak face‑to‑face naturally.
For phone calls, online meetings, or media playback: Open the Timekettle app and select the appropriate mode (e.g., Call Mode, Meeting Mode, or Media Mode) to match your activity.

Touch controls: Use double‑tap, triple‑tap, or long‑press gestures to play/pause, skip tracks, answer or end calls, and more. All gestures are customizable — check the user manual or the app's touch settings for detailed instructions.

headings: When should I use "Fast" vs. "Accurate" translation on W4 Plus?
paras: Great question. The W4 Plus gives you two translation modes to match your needs:

Fast Translation is all about speed. It delivers almost instant results, making it perfect for quick exchanges — like ordering food, asking for directions, or casual small talk. The trade‑off is that it may miss some nuances.

Accurate Translation takes a bit more time (still just seconds) because it waits for a full sentence, then applies an advanced AI model to understand context, correct errors, and refine the output. This ensures professional‑grade precision for conference calls, contract discussions, or formal presentations.
The best part? You can toggle between the two with a single tap at the top of the translation screen — no need to pause or restart your conversation.

headings: What can I use W4 Plus for? What modes does it have?
paras: W4 Plus adapts to almost any cross‑language scenario with four dedicated modes — all using the same set of earbuds and the same powerful cloud translation engine:

Two‑Person Conversation Mode — Give one earbud to your conversation partner. You'll both hear instant, two‑way translations with near‑zero delay. Perfect for face‑to‑face negotiations, traveling with friends, or bargaining at local markets.

On‑Site Listening Mode — Wear both earbuds and listen to one‑way real‑time translations. Great for attending academic lectures, following guided tours in foreign languages, or sitting through international conferences.

Call Translation Mode — Make or receive cross‑border calls and online meetings without asking the other party to install anything. The app translates both sides and saves bilingual transcripts for later review.
Audio & Video Translation Mode — Watch foreign movies, live broadcasts, or YouTube videos with real‑time subtitles while still hearing the original audio — so you never miss the emotion or context.
Best of all? You don't need to change hardware for different scenarios. Just switch modes in the app, and you're ready to go.

headings: With so many W4 models, which one is right for me?
paras: Instead of a one‑size‑fits‑all answer, let's walk through three dimensions:
① What features do you use most?
② Do you prefer a one‑time payment or monthly subscription?
③ Do you have specific needs for comfort and battery life?
If you're on a budget and mainly need face‑to‑face translation:
Choose W4. It's the most affordable and compact option, with unlimited One‑on‑One and Listen & Play — perfect for occasional cross‑language encounters.
If you want to test premium features at a low cost and subscribe only as needed:

Choose W4 Plus Subscription. Basic translation is unlimited, and premium features (Call Translation, Media Translation, AI Features) come with a 7‑day free trial — you only pay monthly after that. Flexible and cost‑efficient.
If you're a heavy user who wants everything permanently unlocked:

Choose W4 Plus (One-time Purchase). One payment gives you permanent access to Call/Media Translation, VoiceFocus, and the full AI suite (AI Specialized Translation, AI Conversation Memory, AI Live Summary). No monthly fees — ideal for foreign trade, cross‑border professionals, and frequent travelers.
If you're a business user who values comfort, long battery, and audio quality:

Choose W4 Pro. The open‑ear design makes it comfortable for all‑day wear, with 6+ hours of continuous translation and superior sound quality — ideal for indoor business negotiations and extended meetings.
Essential face‑to‑face translation → W4
Flexible monthly access to premium features → W4 Plus Subscription
Fully unlocked, permanent ownership → W4 Plus (One-time Purchase)
Long battery, comfort, flagship business → W4 Pro

headings: When does bone‑conduction voiceprint pickup activate? Does it work during regular calls?
paras: Bone‑conduction pickup is automatically enabled only in translation modes — specifically during Two‑Person Conversation and On‑Site Listening when you are speaking.
It does not activate during regular phone calls, music playback, or any non‑translation use.
This design ensures the feature is used precisely where it's needed — capturing your voice clearly through vibration in noisy environments — without interfering with everyday audio functions.

headings: What makes W4 Plus so much better at picking up and recognizing my voice?
paras: The secret is a powerful combination of specialized hardware and smart algorithms:

Hardware advantage: W4 Plus is equipped with one bone‑conducting voiceprint sensor and two air‑conduction microphones. While the microphones pick up sound waves, the bone sensor captures your voice through skull vibration — which means it cuts through background noise to hear you clearly.

Algorithm power: These hardware inputs feed into a hybrid processing pipeline that includes dual‑mic pickup, VAD (Voice Activity Detection) noise reduction, and our proprietary VoiceFocus algorithm. Together, they separate your voice from the crowd with impressive precision.
Compared to the previous generation (W3), W4 Plus delivers a 25% boost in recognition accuracy.
For Chinese‑English translation, it hits 92% accuracy — reliable enough for business and professional use.
In quiet settings or when you speak softly, the error rate drops by 32% to 47%.
And in noisy environments (like busy streets or crowded lobbies), you don't need to shout — just speak naturally, and W4 Plus will catch every word.

headings: What is Babel OS 3.0? How does it improve translation quality?
paras: Babel OS 3.0 is Timekettle's proprietary end‑to‑end AI translation system, purpose‑built for the W4 Plus — handling everything from speech recognition to final output. It delivers three major upgrades over the previous generation:

More accurate — A large language model (LLM) drives the entire translation reasoning process, boosting accuracy by ≥30%. Built‑in AI Refine and error correction ensure even long or casual sentences sound natural and fluent.

Faster & more stable — Auto‑matches the optimal engine for each language, with global server nodes maintaining stable connections even on weak networks. Seamless switching between online and offline modes.
Broader & more native — Supports 52 languages and 106 accents, delivering idiomatic results even for less commonly spoken languages.
In short: It's smarter, faster, and sounds more like you.

headings: Do call translation and audio/video translation require the other party to have a device? Which apps are supported?
paras: The other party does NOT need any device or earbuds — only you need the W4 Plus.
Call Translation works with system phone calls and major communication/meeting apps, including WeChat, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, DingTalk, WhatsApp, and more.
Audio & Video Translation supports popular streaming platforms like YouTube, Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, and others.
In short: If you can hear it on your phone, W4 Plus can translate it — the other side doesn't need to install or wear anything.

headings: Is call translation bidirectional? Can I hear both the original audio and the translation? Can I prevent the other party from hearing my original voice?
paras: Yes, call translation is fully bidirectional — both sides are translated in real time.
You can adjust the volume of the original audio and the translated audio independently to suit your preference.

After updating to the latest firmware, you can disable the option that lets the other party hear your original voice. Once turned off, they will onlyhear the translated version of what you say — your original voice remains private to you.
Tip: Check for firmware updates in the app to access this privacy feature.

headings: What is the VoiceFocus algorithm? Which versions support it?
paras: VoiceFocus is a focused noise‑reduction pickup algorithm that dramatically improves voice recognition accuracy in low‑volume and noisy environments — so you can be understood clearly even when you speak softly or the room is loud.
✅ W4 Plus (Subscription) and W4 Plus (One-time Purchase) — both include VoiceFocus.
❌ W4 (original) — does not support VoiceFocus.If you want the best performance in challenging acoustic conditions, choose a W4 Plus model.

headings: How does the 7‑day free trial work? What happens after it ends?
paras: The subscription version includes a 7‑day free trial for Audio/Video Translation, Call Translation, and all advanced AI features.
After the trial, your subscription will automatically renew at the standard rate unless you cancel before the trial ends.
If you choose not to subscribe, those premium features will be locked — but the basic Two‑Person Conversation and On‑Site Listening modes remain free and unlimited, completely unaffected.
Tip: Cancel via the app store (Apple/Google) at least 24 hours before the trial ends to avoid charges.

headings: How is the battery life and charging performance of W4 Plus?
paras: Per earbud: Continuous translation >3 hours (at 50% volume), music playback 6 hours.
Charging case: Recharges earbuds 2~3 times — total combined battery: 12 hours for translation, 18 hours for music.
Charging time: Earbuds fully charge in ~50 minutes; case (Type‑C, 5V1A) fully charges in ~1.5 hours.
Standby & care: Standby time up to 6 months on a full charge. For optimal battery health, we recommend charging at least once a month.

Foreign trade, overseas sales, and cross‑border e‑commerce professionals
Expatriates and frequent international business travelers
Anyone who needs clear, accurate translation in noisy environments (trade shows, restaurants, factories, etc.)
In short: if cross‑language communication is part of your daily routine, W4 Plus is your go‑to interpreter.

headings: How long is AI conversation memory retained? Does it persist after the session ends?
paras: AI Conversation Memory applies only to the current translation session and does not persist across sessions.
When enabled, it uses preceding context within that session to improve consistency and accuracy. Once the current session ends or a new session begins, previous context is not carried over.
This feature does not permanently retain conversation content across sessions — context is released when the session ends.
